websocket: client half driven here through a scriptable double (no ssh pty); server half covered for real by test/v2-term-ws.test.js, which boots server.js on a scratch port with a fake ssh first on PATH and asserts the pty stream, the input and resize frames, the single exit control frame and the 4400 closes

results.action: load the Windows screen with no sessions
results.expectation: the improvised empty state carries the ruling copy verbatim
results.note: There are no sessions yet, open a new session via an orchestrator first.

results.action: render the empty state with the grid collapsed
results.expectation: it is anchored to the nearest sized ancestor, so it is actually on screen

results.action: inspect FD.fixture in live mode with no sessions
results.expectation: l3Tiles is published and empty; no seed tiles leak into live mode

results.action: load /api/sessions through FD.data in live mode
results.expectation: the ≡ switcher lists exactly the live, non-hidden sessions

results.action: openTile(host, name)
results.expectation: one tile is rendered

results.action: read the tile header
results.expectation: the header shows the session name and its box

results.action: read the tile footer
results.expectation: foot1 is the registry role · label, foot2 is the registry task

results.action: inspect the WebSocket the tile opened
results.expectation: ws://<host>/term?host&session&cols&rows, both values URI-encoded

results.action: let the socket open
results.expectation: a {type:"resize"} frame is replayed on open

results.action: server sends pty bytes
results.expectation: the bytes are written to the terminal

results.action: server sends the exit control frame
results.expectation: the control frame is dropped, never written to the terminal

results.action: openTile the same host+session again
results.expectation: the tile is deduped on host+NUL+session — no second tile, no reconnect

results.action: type into the focused terminal
results.expectation: each keystroke is sent as {type:"input",data}

results.action: openMax(host, name)
results.expectation: the overlay opens and the live terminal is aligned over its body, above it in z

results.action: read the full-screen header and footer
results.expectation: name, host and the registry role · label · task are shown

results.action: double-click a tile bar away from its buttons
results.expectation: the tile maximizes

results.action: double-click the full-screen header away from its buttons
results.expectation: it restores

results.action: open the ≡ menu
results.expectation: it lists the live sessions with dot, name and host — the old drawer switcher

results.action: pick another session from the ≡ menu
results.expectation: that session is attached (deduped) and becomes the maximized one

results.action: with two tiles open and one maximized
results.expectation: exactly one terminal is raised over the full screen at a time

results.action: press plain Escape with the terminal focused
results.expectation: plain Escape reaches tmux/vim and does not restore

results.action: press shift+Escape
results.expectation: the maximized tile is restored

results.action: click Message in the full-screen header
results.expectation: FD.screens.bus.open({type:"tmux",host,session}) is called

results.action: click Close in the full-screen header
results.expectation: the overlay closes and the tiles come back

results.action: the socket closes after a locked-agent tail
results.expectation: a Disconnected overlay appears with the 1Password note and a Reconnect button
results.note: Disconnected · 1Password locked — unlock it, then Reconnect · Reconnect

results.action: click Reconnect
results.expectation: a fresh socket is opened and the overlay clears

results.action: click the ✕ on the second tile
results.expectation: that tile closes, the first stays open, and no API call is made — the remote session survives

results.action: connectAll()
results.expectation: every live non-hidden session opens, 500 ms apart, hidden and dead rows skipped

results.action: click the sidebar Connect all once
results.expectation: exactly one connectAll call — the shell owns the binding, this slice adds none

results.action: inspect what connectAll opened
results.expectation: no hidden and no dead session was attached

results.action: inspect where every xterm mount lives
results.expectation: no terminal is mounted inside a compiled node — the layer is a sibling of #dc-root

results.action: inspect the compiled tiles for slice state
results.expectation: no per-row state is stored on a positional sc-for row

results.action: watch the console for the whole run
results.expectation: zero console errors

results.action: open a tile and send nothing for 15 s
results.expectation: the stall line appears with its copy verbatim
results.note: no output — 1Password on this Mac may be locked or waiting for approval

results.action: the pty finally sends output
results.expectation: the stall line is cleared on the first message

results.action: run the whole screen in the light theme
results.expectation: the improvised nodes read the light palette from the mock tokens

results.action: load the app with ?fixture=1
results.expectation: this slice never calls FD.setData in fixture mode and builds no layer

results.action: watch the network with ?fixture=1
results.expectation: no /api/* request is made from the Windows screen
